# Ánh Dương runtime rule

Read `docs/AGENT_RUNTIME_CONTRACT.md` before changing Ánh Dương.

Run `/usr/local/libexec/anh-duong/runtime-truth` first. Treat its fresh systemd/process/health/data output as authoritative over static paths or ports in old docs and artifacts. Use an isolated worktree, preserve unrelated changes, and stop before production deploy/restart unless the owner gate is approved.
